## Projects

### DriftSense

- What: Finds where a wafer-inspection microscope actually is — under unknown 8–12× zoom and ±5° rotation — or says the pattern isn’t there.
- Role: team lead
- Result: match F1 0.91 on 2,250 pairs · CAD-to-SEM within 1 px on 600
- Tag: runner-up · SEMICON India 2026
- Code: public code
- Case study: https://vhmaadhav.com/work/driftsense/
- Public repository: https://github.com/vhmaadhav/semicon-driftsense

### VehicleGPT

- What: Ask a car about its own data: a small LLM answering from CAN logs, fully offline.
- Role: team lead · benchmark harness
- Result: hybrid 29.5% → 95.5% on 200 q · best single model 82% @ 1.74 s, 2 cores / 2 GiB
- Tag: Tata Elxsi Teliport S4
- Code: code private (competition)
- Case study: https://vhmaadhav.com/work/vehiclegpt/

### Mouna

- What: Speak by mouthing words — silent lip-reading turned into voice on a phone NPU, no internet.
- Result: false utterances 23% → 7% · Kannada top-1 75.3%
- Tag: grand finale · iQOO 2026
- Code: code private

### DT Guardian

- What: Simulated edge controller for a 200 kVA transformer: MILP scheduling of battery, EV charging and pump loads.
- Role: co-developer (2-person team)
- Result: energy not served, 6 h outage: 121.2 → 56.7 kWh (−53%)
- Tag: phase 2 · Schneider Yuva Yodha
- Code: code private (competition)
- Case study: https://vhmaadhav.com/work/dt-guardian/

## Currently working

### Rakshak-Edge

- What: Catches scam SMS and links on an Arm device, offline — and refuses explanations it can’t back up.
- Status: phase 1 due nov 2026 · Arm × Bharat AI-SoC · team lead
- Code: code private until phase 1

### Interfacial Heat Transport Prediction

- What: A model for how well heat crosses the boundary between two solids, which has to beat the standard mismatch models on interfaces it has never seen.
- Status: planning · benchmark first · Discovered Materials Grand Challenge
- Code: code private

### Low-Cost Axial-Flow Ventricular Assist Device

- What: A cheap, magnetically coupled axial-flow blood pump with a see-through housing, so clots can be seen forming. A benchtop research prototype, built with a mechanical engineering student and a doctor as clinical advisor.
- Status: phase 0 · CAD + CFD · water and blood-analogue tests only
- Code: code private

### One-Pass Neural Network Repair

- What: Can a small network look at a corrupted, pruned or forgetful model and predict the weight patch that fixes it, with no retraining?
- Status: phase 0 · benchmark and tuned baselines
- Code: code private

### Adaptive Recurrent Depth in Looped LLMs

- What: Which questions an extra recurrent loop fixes, leaves alone or breaks in looped language models, and whether that can be predicted when the data shifts.
- Status: setup · Ouro-1.4B · GSM8K → MATH-500 / BBH / GPQA
- Code: code private

### LLM Quantization & Inference Lab

- What: Hands-on quantization and serving experiments, starting with FP8 inference for a 27B Qwen model.
- Status: learning log
- Code: public code
- Public repository: https://github.com/vhmaadhav/quantization-lab

### Axiom Trace

- What: A tutor that knows what you know: knowledge-graph RAG with mastery tracking and animated ECE explanations.
- Status: personal project · solo · Next.js web + Kotlin app
- Code: code private for now
